name: @w6w-apps/gamma
description: Generate presentations, documents, webpages, and social posts with Gamma's AI, and manage the results.

w6w.longDescription:
Gamma turns a topic or an existing document into a polished presentation, document, webpage, or social post using AI. This app covers the Gamma Public API end to end: kick off a generation from raw text or a multi-page outline, or adapt an existing Gamma as a template; poll for the result (view URL, export URL, and credit usage); and generate a standalone on-brand image the same way.

Beyond generation, it covers the management surface a workflow needs to operate on what it created — searching gammas and templates, reading metadata and comment threads, archiving, exporting to PDF/PPTX/PNG, and deleting — plus doc-level, per-card, and per-viewer engagement analytics for a finished Gamma.

A health check tracks Gamma's own status page (status.gamma.app), and the credential probe (List Themes) needs no more permission than an ordinary workspace member has, so a scoped-down key still reports healthy.
